title.narrative: Strengthening Multimodal and Integrated Logistics Ecosystem Program (Subprogram 2)

description.narrative: The Strengthening Multimodal and Integrated Logistics Ecosystem (SMILE) program is a programmatically approached policy-based lending comprising two subprograms. The program aims to expand India's manufacturing sector and improve resilience of its supply chains through the establishment and operationalization of a comprehensive policy framework. Logistics efficiency will be enhanced through (i) strengthening the institutional bases for multimodal logistics infrastructure development at the national, state, and city levels; (ii) standardizing warehousing and other logistics assets to strengthen supply chains and incentivize greater private sector investment; (iii) improving efficiencies in external trade logistics; and (iv) adopting smart systems for efficient and low-emission logistics. Subprogram 1 included critical policy and institutional reforms in the logistics sector including launch of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan (PMGS-NMP) for Multi-Modal Connectivity and the National Logistics Policy (NLP) by the Government of India. Subprogram 2 builds on subprogram 1 reforms and further operationalize and implement PMGS-NMP and the NLP at the central, state and local government levels, while expanding the reforms taken to more agencies, states and municipalities.

Action 1: The Government of India has approved the NLP, which aims to develop an integrated, cost-effective, reliable, resilient, sustainable, and digitally enabled logistics ecosystem to support accelerated and inclusive economic growth. The NLP streamlines processes, strengthens regulatory and institutional framework, and adoption of technology to significantly improve logistics efficiency. Target value: 15
Action 2: MOCI has approved the institutional framework for implementing PMGS-NMP, which includes (i) an Empowered Group of Secretaries comprising senior officials of central ministries for coordinated implementation of PMGS-NMP, and (ii) a network planning group for assisting the Empowered Group of Secretaries in coordinating and implementing an integrated multimodal network that will enable the coordination of plans submitted by various ministries and states. Target value: 15
Action 1: (i) The Government has initiated the implementation of the institutional arrangements established in 20 states for PM GATI SHAKTI by ensuring that 4 states have mandated the planning of infrastructure projects above a minimum threshold using the PM GATI SHAKTI NMP;c (ii) the Technical Support Unit (TSU) has commenced evaluation of projects based on PM GatiShakti principles for integrated planningd; (iii) the adoption of state logistics policies has been expanded to additional 5e states with a cumulative approval of logistics policies by 24 state governments, and (iv) 6 cities approved with immediate effect their city logistics plans. Target value: 15
